en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, rectangular, three‑storey classical building with a dark roof and many evenly spaced windows, fronted by a broad cobblestone square. Trees partially frame the building on both sides, and small figures walk across the open square. Printed caption text appears along the bottom left, and a small triangular publisher's logo with a number is at the bottom right.
